canonicalOwners.text: 接待区：单套珠光建筑艺术系统局限于一处侧向建筑附近，主曲面及少量辅助薄层在局部明确收束，薄边、层间留缝与自然透景保持辨识度；艺术点睛服务于建筑，前台上方和主厅中央保留完整顶面与开敞尺度。
接待主厅：完整实体墙、入口建筑框景与可读顶面建立开阔横向大厅，清楚可见的完整前台组织到达服务，成组候客与前台横向联系，专业面询位于主厅边缘。
接待主厅：左前景以完整入口框景、实体建筑与开放地面建立公共到达空间，入口到前台视线及接近路径连续可读，左侧层次仅由既有建筑和正常采光表达。
接待主厅：仅一套主珠光曲面依附一处侧向建筑界面，完整主曲面与少量辅助薄层在同一局部起止收束，上部衔接止于该侧界面附近；中央及前台上方保留完整安静顶面，薄边、层间留缝和透景深度清楚。
接待主厅：边缘半开放皮肤/美学面询位仅以一小段局部半透明边界保护私密，专业台面的设备操作侧设面询人员座位，对侧设访客座位，空椅隔台相向且可共同看屏；后续私密服务入口由错位实体界面屏蔽。

A complete reception counter recognizable from the oblique entrance as the primary service anchor; service front, staff worktop, small office equipment and visitor approach are readable at credible scale
One complete sofa and armchair waiting group with small tables, usable seating and conversation space, warm neutral upholstery and light timber details, with circulation clear around it

One edge semi-open skin/facial aesthetics advisory node: professional worktop, dedicated display, consultant chair on its equipment-operation side and guest chair opposite, facing across the worktop with shared screen visibility; a simple light screen shows abstract skin surface texture, facial contour zones or aesthetic proportion diagrams, without skull, brain folds, cross-sections, CT/MRI, organs, readable text, numbers, diagnoses, personal images or outcome promises; a short translucent boundary protects privacy

An open left foreground with entrance framing, solid architecture and clear approach to reception; in this shot it contains no separate circular glass room, cylindrical enclosure, ring pendant or purposeless display

Only one pearlescent architectural system at one side interface: a complete local main curve, few thin layers, fine edges and see-through depth; its upper junction ends near that side, leaving the central and reception ceiling open, with only a short advisory privacy boundary instead of a surrounding arch or cross-hall ribbon

One small flat clean unlettered identity surface on an architectural interface, outside the main circulation and unobstructed; small operational carriers remain subordinate to the complete functional areas

userConfirmedVisualDecision.sourceDocument: 2026-10-19 用户授权P6项目级离线修正：以b79f741e及P5确认副本为基线，仅清退本镜头左前景无功能围合、限制顶部珠光跨度、明确皮肤面部美学屏幕及隔台相向座位。保留前台候客、开阔主厅、暖色材料、珠光薄边弱紫、光线和私密转场。仅新数据隔离副本，通过正式网页保存确认、业务编译、零参考标准预演与离线回归；真实模型、重试重生成及自动纠正均0。若编译丢失关键字段则停止报告，不改生产代码。完成提交审查证据后停止待用户审核。
